items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: And that's how we used to learn how to play about getting King Oliver's records.

ctx.x: Well, you like King Oliver, then? You listen to King Oliver?

Yeah, we used to have King Oliver at that time was making records, you understand? And that's how we used to learn how to play about getting King Oliver's records. Put them on the box and we'd play behind them records.
There's one of those fool motorcycles outside. I couldn't hear what you were saying.
